title: Remote viewing continued under OSAP

tellings.quote: on. And I mean, you even if you read skim marketers at the Pentagon, it was definitely still going on in the context of Osap

plain: Remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant places or objects with the mind alone, was still going on inside OSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained phenomena, according to Michels. He says this himself, pointing to the book Skinwalkers at the Pentagon and saying that even a skim of it makes this clear. If so, the Pentagon's interest in psychic methods went on well after its better-known psychic programmes.
